escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution in Orchestrator
escalations.reason: Arbitrary code execution in production orchestrator infrastructure. If attacker controls Docker API responses or crafts protobuf messages, can execute arbitrary code in orchestrator process.

escalations.title: Handlebars Template Injection (via ts-jest dev dependency chain)
escalations.reason: Multiple template injection CVEs (8 GHSA advisories). Dev-time only — verify ts-jest never compiles user-controlled template data during CI builds.
escalations.immediate_fix: Upgrade ts-jest to latest; coordinate handlebars upgrade path

p1_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Blind to portal/ and platform/ Codebases
p1_findings.description: The enforcer scans only Source/ and E2E/ — two entire codebases (portal/, platform/) with ~95 requirements are excluded. Default gate reports PASS while most requirements are unverified.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend source_dirs in traceability-enforcer.py to include portal/ and platform/. Add per-codebase enforcer invocations to CLAUDE.md.

p1_findings.title: pending_dependencies Status Missing from WorkItemStatus Enum
p1_findings.description: api-contracts.md and FR-dependency-dispatch-gating specify status transition to pending_dependencies when blockers exist. Enum has no such member, transition table lacks entry, dispatch endpoint returns 400 instead. Verifies comment is a false claim.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add PendingDependencies to WorkItemStatus enum. Add transition rules. Update approve/dispatch endpoints. Mirror portal/ implementation.
